exposure: normal GCT with impaired fasting glucose
normal GCT with gestational glucose intolerance
cohort: Pregnant women undergoing glucose tolerance testing
finding: Women with abnormal glucose homeostasis, even those not meeting the criteria for gestational diabetes, experience higher rates of adverse maternal outcomes including hypertensive disorders of pregnancy and caesarean section.
mod_finding: The rate of elective caesarean section was significantly higher in the gestational diabetes group compared to other groups with abnormal glucose homeostasis.
